dedupe_keys.name: fedwire funds service volume and value statistics

description: The Federal Reserve Banks publish volume and value statistics for the Fedwire Funds Service, the Federal Reserve's funds transfer service in the United States, as monthly, quarterly and annual tables. The annual table, last updated on 26 January 2026, lists for each year the number of transfers originated, annual volume growth, value of transfers originated in millions of dollars, value growth, average value per transfer and average daily volume and value; in 2025 the service carried 217,296,700 transfers worth about 1.148 quadrillion dollars, about 869,000 transfers and 4.6 trillion dollars per day. Access is free: the tables are HTML web pages that can be read or copied. The pages read state no licence. Caveats: the statistics are aggregates without participant or intraday detail, and values are nominal. For simulation they give the daily throughput of the main U.S. wholesale payment system, a baseline for outage impact, liquidity and cascading-failure scenarios in financial infrastructure. Related catalogue records include the Federal Reserve Payments Study and the BIS CPMI Red Book statistics.
